data.narrative:
Spaceium is a Seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by orbital mechanics and propulsion specialists with NASA and legacy engine heritage (LR-101 lineage). The company has raised $6.3M to date. The valuation universe comprises 6 public Space & Aerospace comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX and Sierra Space, though no direct same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables exist with sufficient data density.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using total raised ($6.3M) as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression yields $15.75M. Public comps in the sector trade at a median 23.9x P/S, but cannot be applied without disclosed revenue. Peer-median analysis across the broader 11-company Space & Aerospace universe lacks sufficient granularity at equivalent stages to warrant reliance; similarly scoped private comps do not meet minimum thresholds.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $18M, centered at $16M. This reflects a moderate markup on capital deployed, consistent with early-stage progression in capital-intensive, highly technical sectors. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or near-term milestones, lack of narrow-set peer benchmarks, and the outsized influence of founder pedigree relative to product-market fit signals. Further data on technical milestones and customer traction would strengthen conviction.
